name: Camtech (SA)
summary: University of Adelaide IT company (Campus Technologies, from 1983; hardware/computer shops); ISP arm from 1994 (AARNet VAR), SA internet business sold to OzEmail March 1998.

events.details: University of Adelaide company (est. 1983, name a contraction of Campus Technologies; campus computer shops + hardware). Internet work from ~1988 via the University ('10 years experience' per its 1998 profile); AARNet Value Added Reseller 1994 - start of ISP operation. Retail access business built over ~3 years to the Mar 1998 OzEmail sale; earliest Wayback capture 31 Oct 1996.

refs.label: Roger Clarke's Brief History of the Internet in Australia: Camtech among the 1994 AARNet VARs
Camtech corporate profile (May 1998): est. 1983, '10 years experience in the Internet', access business 'built over three years'

events.details: OzEmail acquired Camtech's SA internet service business (31 March 1998); Camtech itself continued as an IT company (camtech.com.au live to ~2011).
